name: The Court of Echoing Whispers
description: An organized collective of powerful, sentient dream entities who seek to permanently cross the Veil and reshape reality.
goals: Weaken the Veil at strategic points to allow major incursions
Corrupt or subvert Anchorhold rituals from within
Capture the unlikely guardian to use its nature as a key to unlock the Veil
resources: Legions of lesser dream entities, ability to manipulate the mutable wilderness, psychic influence over sleepers and the unstable, dream-forged ephemeral constructs.
original_description: An organized collective of powerful, sentient dream entities who seek to permanently cross the Veil and reshape reality.
